name: Everest Base Camp Trek
alt_names: Everest Base Camp and Kala Patthar Trek
sub_region: Solukhumbu District, Koshi Province (Sagarmatha National Park, Khumbu Pasang Lhamu Rural Municipality)

difficulty.notes: Non-technical teahouse trek; difficulty comes from altitude (nights up to 5,164 m at Gorak Shep) and 5-8 hour days. The Lobuche-Gorak Shep-EBC day and the Kala Patthar-Pheriche day are the longest (7-8 h).

duration_days.basis: Full trip Kathmandu-Kathmandu (about 11-12 trekking days Lukla-Lukla)
duration_days.notes: Standard 14-day plan includes two acclimatisation days (Namche, Dingboche) and a Kathmandu buffer day for Lukla flight delays. Variants: return by helicopter from Gorak Shep/Kala Patthar (shortens by 2-3 days); EBC via Gokyo and Cho La (see gokyo-cho-la-everest-base-camp-trek); classic Jiri/Shivalaya walk-in adds about 5-7 days.

start_point: Kathmandu (fly to Lukla, or drive to Manthali/Ramechhap and fly to Lukla in peak seasons)

itinerary.notes: Lukla about 2,846-2,860 m. In peak seasons flights leave from Manthali (Ramechhap) after a 4-5 h pre-dawn drive.
Hillary suspension bridge; steep final climb; first Everest view.

itinerary.route: Acclimatisation day: Namche - Hotel Everest View / Khumjung - Namche
itinerary.notes: Climb high, sleep low (Hotel Everest View about 3,880 m).
Enter the Imja valley; above the treeline.

itinerary.route: Acclimatisation day: Dingboche - Nangkartshang hill - Dingboche

itinerary.notes: Climbers' memorials at Thukla Pass (about 4,830 m).

itinerary.route: Lobuche - Gorak Shep - Everest Base Camp - Gorak Shep
itinerary.notes: Everest Base Camp 5,364 m beside the Khumbu Icefall.

itinerary.route: Gorak Shep - Kala Patthar (sunrise) - Gorak Shep - Pheriche
itinerary.notes: Kala Patthar: 1.5-2 h ascent from Gorak Shep; best close view of Everest summit.

itinerary.route: Lukla - Kathmandu (flight; or Lukla - Manthali flight + drive)

best_seasons.notes: NTB: best October-November and March-May; December-February snow and cold (daytime about 5 C); June-September monsoon. Lukla flights are most disrupted by cloud in monsoon.

permits.name: Sagarmatha National Park entry permit
permits.fee: NPR 3,000 per person per entry (SAARC NPR 1,500; children under 10 free)

permits.name: Khumbu Pasang Lhamu Rural Municipality Trek-Card (local entry fee)
permits.fee: NPR 3,000 per person (SAARC and Chinese nationals NPR 2,000)

permits.name: TIMS card
permits.fee: Not collected in Khumbu (the Trek-Card is used instead); NTB nonetheless lists EBC under its TIMS/guide rule

guide_requirements: Conflicting. NTB's revised TIMS provision (effective 31 March 2023) lists the Everest Base Camp trek among routes where a licensed guide and agency-issued TIMS card are required. Khumbu Pasang Lhamu Rural Municipality publicly said in April 2023 that hiring a guide is not mandatory in the Everest region and issues its own Trek-Card. 2026 operator sources report independent trekkers still enter without guides and that no checkpoint asks for guide papers (current enforcement UNVERIFIED).

flights: Kathmandu - Lukla (Tenzing-Hillary Airport) about 30-40 min, Tara Air, Summit Air, Sita Air

Peak-season diversion: CAAN routes Lukla flights via Manthali Airport, Ramechhap, roughly spring Chaitra-Jestha (about mid-March to May/June) and autumn first week of Ashwin to 15 Mangsir (about late September to end of November); Manthali-Lukla about 20 min; 50-65 flights/day in good weather (autumn 2025)
Optional helicopter return from Gorak Shep/Pheriche (charter)
drives: Kathmandu - Manthali (Ramechhap) about 4-5 h, about 125 km via BP Highway, pre-dawn departure, when flights are diverted
logistics.notes: Rain or highway blockages can strand trekkers at Manthali (Oct 2025: 150+ waiting after rain). Keep at least one buffer day before international departure.

highlights: Everest Base Camp (5,364 m) at the foot of the Khumbu Icefall
Sunrise view of Everest from Kala Patthar
Namche Bazaar, the Sherpa trading town
Tengboche Monastery with Ama Dablam backdrop
Sagarmatha National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site
risks: Acute mountain sickness (sleeping altitude 5,164 m at Gorak Shep)
Lukla/Manthali flight delays and cancellations due to weather
Cold nights (well below freezing above Dingboche in Oct-Nov and winter)
Yak and porter traffic on narrow trails and suspension bridges

acclimatization.notes: Both days use climb-high-sleep-low hikes (Hotel Everest View about 3,880 m; Nangkartshang about 5,083 m).

unverified: Kala Patthar height: commonly listed as 5,545 m (used here, and by most operators); Wikipedia cites GPS readings of 5,643-5,644.5 m for the prayer-flag summit trekkers reach.
Current (2026) enforcement of the national licensed-guide rule in Khumbu: operators say it is not enforced; NTB still lists EBC under the rule.
Whether a TIMS card is ever checked on the EBC route in 2026 (operators say no).
Exact CAAN Manthali diversion dates for each season (published in Nepali months; Gregorian dates approximate).
